title: Antigravity Lifecycle Hooks
description: JSON schema for Antigravity lifecycle hooks configuration (hooks.json). Supports both Antigravity native named hooks and wrapped/Claude-compatible hook configurations.

anyOf.title: Antigravity Native Hooks Format
anyOf.description: Map of user-defined hook names to hook specifications.

anyOf.title: Wrapped / Claude-Compatible Hooks Format
anyOf.description: Top-level hooks container with optional description.

description.description: Human-readable description of the hook suite.

eventMap.description: Map of lifecycle event names to hook handlers or hook groups.

SessionStart.description: Handlers executed when a new conversation session starts.

PreInvocation.description: Handlers executed before the model is invoked for an agent turn.

PostInvocation.description: Handlers executed after tool calls finish for an agent turn.

Stop.description: Handlers executed when the agent execution loop terminates.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Handlers executed when a user submits a prompt.

PreToolUse.description: Handlers executed before a tool executes.

PostToolUse.description: Handlers executed after a tool completes. Only command hooks are supported (prompt hooks are rejected).

namedHookSpec.description: Lifecycle hook specification for an individual named hook.

enabled.description: Whether this named hook is enabled. Defaults to true.

SessionStart.description: Handlers executed when a new conversation session starts.

PreInvocation.description: Handlers executed before the model is invoked for an agent turn.

PostInvocation.description: Handlers executed after tool calls finish for an agent turn.

Stop.description: Handlers executed when the agent execution loop terminates.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Handlers executed when a user submits a prompt.

PreToolUse.description: Handlers executed before a tool executes.

PostToolUse.description: Handlers executed after a tool completes. Only command hooks are supported (prompt hooks are rejected).

eventHandlerList.description: List of hook handlers or tool-matcher groups.

postToolHandlerList.description: List of command hook handlers or tool-matcher groups for PostToolUse.

toolHookGroup.description: Associates a tool name matcher pattern with a list of hook handlers.

matcher.description: Pattern or regular expression matching tool names (e.g. 'run_command', 'run_command|view_file', '*', or '').

hooks.description: List of hook handlers to execute when the matcher matches.

postToolHookGroup.description: Associates a tool name matcher pattern with command hook handlers. Prompt hooks cannot be used in PostToolUse.

matcher.description: Pattern or regular expression matching tool names (e.g. 'run_command', 'run_command|view_file', '*', or '').

hooks.description: List of command hook handlers to execute after tool completion.

hookHandler.description: An individual lifecycle hook handler. Can be either a shell command hook or an AI prompt hook.

commandHook.description: Executes a shell command or script during the lifecycle event.

type.description: Hook handler action type. Defaults to 'command'.

command.description: The shell command to execute (run via 'sh -c' on Unix, 'cmd /c' on Windows).

timeout.description: Execution timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.

shell.description: Specific shell binary to execute the command with (e.g. 'bash', 'sh').

async.description: Whether to execute the hook command asynchronously in the background.

promptHook.description: Evaluates an AI prompt instruction during the lifecycle event.

type.description: Hook handler action type. Set to 'prompt' for model prompt evaluation.

prompt.description: The prompt instruction text sent to the model.

model.description: The model used to evaluate the prompt. Defaults to 'inherit'.
